terra.problem: “Then” claims that the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt after destroying the Amorite; the verses do not state that sequence.

The verses do not say that the swift, the strong, and the archer will not save their lives. They say that escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength, and the archer will not stand his ground.
